articles.title: Claude文本水印技术细节公开
articles.summary: Anthropic宣布将采用谷歌DeepMind的SynthID-Text技术，为Claude生成的文本添加隐形水印，以符合欧洲AI透明度法规。
articles.why: 水印技术让AI生成内容可追溯，影响内容创作者和普通用户对AI文本的信任。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI生成内容如何被识别，未来你可能需要辨别哪些文本是AI写的。
articles.for_me: 作为AI工具使用者，了解水印有助于你判断内容来源，但暂时不影响日常使用。

articles.title: AI自动化初创Relay关闭，团队加入谷歌Chrome
articles.summary: AI自动化初创公司Relay关闭，其团队加入谷歌Chrome团队，未来将在浏览器中集成AI功能。
articles.why: 谷歌将AI融入浏览器，可能改变普通用户的上网体验，让AI更易用。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 留意Chrome浏览器即将推出的AI功能，可能让你更便捷地处理日常任务。
articles.for_me: 你常用的浏览器将变得更智能，未来可能直接帮你总结网页或写邮件，值得期待。

articles.title: 亚马逊销毁珍稀书籍训练AI
articles.summary: 亚马逊为训练大语言模型，销毁部分珍稀书籍，引发对文化遗产保护的争议。
articles.why: AI训练数据来源引发伦理问题，影响出版业和知识保存。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 思考AI训练数据的来源是否合理，关注AI发展中的伦理争议。
articles.for_me: 作为文科生，你可能关心书籍被销毁的问题，但这对你的AI学习影响不大。

articles.title: Groq融资3.5亿美元转向Neocloud
articles.summary: AI芯片公司Groq融资3.5亿美元，转型为Neocloud服务商，扩展Nvidia数据中心业务。
articles.why: AI算力需求增长，Neocloud模式可能降低AI开发门槛，让更多小团队用上大模型。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解AI算力服务的发展，未来使用AI工具可能更便宜、更高效。
articles.for_me: 算力服务多样化可能降低AI工具成本，你未来使用AI学习英语可能更实惠。

articles.title: 英伟达投资15亿美元建设OpenAI数据中心
articles.summary: 英伟达向软银数据中心开发商投资15亿美元，确保其芯片用于OpenAI数据中心。
articles.why: 巨头合作加强AI基础设施，推动AI模型性能提升，普通用户将受益于更强大的AI服务。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI基础设施投资，这决定了未来AI工具的能力上限。
articles.for_me: AI模型更强，你用的翻译、写作辅助工具会更智能，有助于英语学习。

articles.title: Wispr融资2.8亿美元，拓展AI会议工具
articles.summary: 语音输入公司Wispr融资2.8亿美元，推出AI会议记录工具，拓展业务范围。
articles.why: AI会议工具能自动记录和总结会议，提高工作效率，适合职场人士。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 尝试使用AI会议工具，体验自动生成会议纪要的便利。
articles.for_me: 如果你需要参加英语会议或课程，这类工具可帮你自动生成笔记，辅助学习。

articles.title: 人形机器人驾驶卡丁车，展示全身智能
articles.summary: 共生知行发布双足人形机器人驾驶卡丁车的Demo，测试机器人的全身协调能力。
articles.why: 人形机器人技术进展，未来可能应用于复杂环境，如家庭服务或救援。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注机器人如何模仿人类动作，这是AI与物理世界交互的关键。
articles.for_me: 机器人技术虽酷，但与你当前学习AI工具关联不大，可作兴趣了解。

articles.title: AI视频工具updream要做创作者的Blender
articles.summary: AI视频生成工具updream爆火后，计划打造类似Blender的创作者工具，降低视频制作门槛。
articles.why: AI视频工具让普通人也能创作高质量视频，推动内容创作民主化。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 尝试用AI视频工具创作，体验从文字到视频的生成过程。
articles.for_me: 作为英语专业学生，你可以用AI视频工具制作英语学习素材，如情景对话视频。

articles.title: 菲尔兹奖得主：AI靠“抬杠”突破数学猜想
articles.summary: 菲尔兹奖得主指出，AI在数学领域的主要突破是通过寻找反例，而非直接证明。
articles.why: AI在科学研究中扮演新角色，可能加速数学和科学发现。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 了解AI如何辅助科研，未来可能成为你的学习伙伴。
articles.for_me: AI的“找反例”能力可启发你批判性思考，但对你备考AI研究生帮助有限。

articles.title: 世界模型进入“有声时代”
articles.summary: AI世界模型实现24FPS画面和48kHz立体声实时生成，即将完全开源。
articles.why: 多模态AI生成能力提升，未来可生成更逼真的虚拟环境，用于游戏、教育等。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注多模态AI发展，未来AI能同时处理视觉和音频，应用更广。
articles.for_me: 多模态AI可辅助英语听力训练，生成真实场景对话，但还需等待成熟产品。

plain_summary: 今天AI圈动静不小，但真正跟你相关的就几件事：谷歌要把AI塞进浏览器，以后上网可能更省事；英伟达砸钱建数据中心，AI会越来越强，你用的翻译、写作工具也会更聪明；还有AI会议工具能自动记笔记，对你学英语可能有用。另外，AI视频工具越来越简单，你可以试着做点英语学习小视频。其他像机器人开车、AI找数学反例，看着热闹，但离你有点远。总之，别被花哨新闻带跑，盯住那些能让AI工具更好用、更便宜的消息就行。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: AI助手性能优化系统，让Claude等工具更聪明
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个给AI助手（比如Claude、Codex等）用的性能优化工具。它解决的是AI助手在复杂任务中容易‘犯迷糊’或效率低下的问题。它通过给AI添加‘技能’（专门的能力）、‘直觉’（快速判断）、‘记忆’（记住上下文）和‘安全’（防止乱来）等功能，让AI更可靠。普通人可能用不上，但如果你是开发者，用Claude Code写代码，装上这个系统，AI就能更好地理解你的项目，减少错误。上手有一定难度，需要懂命令行和配置，适合有编程基础的人。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能自我成长的AI助手，越用越懂你
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI助手框架，特点是‘随着你成长’。它解决的是通用AI助手不够个性化的问题。它允许AI根据你的使用习惯和反馈不断调整自己的行为，就像朋友越来越了解你。比如，你经常让它帮你写邮件，它就会学会你的写作风格；你常问编程问题，它就会更擅长回答。普通人可以用它来打造专属的AI助手，但需要一些技术知识来安装和配置。上手难度中等，适合喜欢折腾的科技爱好者。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让AI自动完成复杂任务的自主智能体
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个开源项目，目标是让AI能自主完成一系列任务，而不需要人类一步步指导。它解决的是‘AI只能回答，不能做事’的问题。比如，你可以让它‘帮我研究一下新能源汽车市场，并写一份报告’，它会自己上网搜索、整理信息、生成报告。普通人也能用，但需要一些设置，比如提供API密钥。上手难度中等，适合想体验AI自动化的人。它让AI从‘聊天’变成‘干活’。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行各种大模型的本地工具
top_starred.explanation: ollama是一个让普通人在自己电脑上轻松运行各种AI大模型的工具。它解决的是‘想用AI但不想用云服务，担心隐私或费用’的问题。你只需要下载安装，然后命令行输入一条命令，就能运行像DeepSeek、Qwen等模型。比如，你可以本地运行一个聊天机器人，完全离线，数据不外传。上手很简单，适合所有对AI感兴趣的人，不需要编程基础，只要会复制粘贴命令就行。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
top_starred.tagline: 大规模抓取网页数据的API工具
top_starred.explanation: firecrawl是一个专门用来抓取网页内容的工具，但比普通爬虫更强大。它解决的是‘需要大量网页数据但不会写爬虫’的问题。它提供API，你只要调用接口，就能把网页内容转成干净的文本或结构化数据。比如，你可以用它收集竞争对手的价格、抓取新闻文章做分析。适合数据分析师、研究者或开发者。上手难度中等，需要懂一点编程，但官方文档很详细。

trending.name: SaladDay/pi-from-scratch
trending.desc: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
trending.tagline: 用600行代码教你从零写AI助手
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个教学示例，用600行TypeScript代码实现了一个迷你版的AI助手（pi-agent）。它解决的是‘想理解AI助手原理但无从下手’的问题。通过阅读代码，你可以看到AI助手是如何处理输入、调用模型、生成输出的。比如，你可以把它当作学习材料，一步步跟着写，理解AI的底层逻辑。适合想深入学习的开发者，需要懂TypeScript和基本AI概念。上手难度较高，但收获很大。

trending.name: elie222/rakazo
trending.desc: Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.
trending.tagline: 开源版Grok Bot，可自定义模型和沙箱
trending.explanation: 这个项目是一个开源的聊天机器人，类似Grok，但你可以自由选择使用哪个AI模型，并且有沙箱环境（隔离运行，更安全）。它解决的是‘想用Grok但不想被绑定’的问题。你可以用自己喜欢的模型，比如本地模型或云模型，还能在沙箱里测试代码，不用担心搞坏系统。适合喜欢定制化的技术爱好者。上手需要一些配置，但不算难。

trending.name: zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Windows / Linux desktop client - bundled Node.js + dsh CLI, one-click launch, 10 built-in UI skins. EAC: Embracing All Creation 揽尽万象
trending.tagline: DeepSeek桌面客户端，一键启动多皮肤
trending.explanation: 这是一个DeepSeek的桌面客户端，让你不用打开网页就能用DeepSeek。它解决了‘网页版用起来不方便’的问题。它自带Node.js环境，一键启动，还有10种界面皮肤。比如，你可以把它当作一个独立的聊天应用，快速打开，界面好看。适合经常用DeepSeek的普通用户，安装简单，不需要技术背景。

trending.name: 0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem: curated plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and the public dsh-plugin topic.
trending.tagline: DeepSeek插件和工具的资源合集
trending.explanation: 这是一个收集DeepSeek相关插件、工具和基础设施的列表。它解决的是‘想扩展DeepSeek功能但不知道去哪找’的问题。它把分散的资源集中起来，比如各种插件、脚本、教程。比如，你想给DeepSeek加个语音输入功能，可以在这里找到现成的插件。适合DeepSeek用户和开发者，浏览即可，无需安装。

trending.name: Electricitysheep/dsh-handbook
trending.desc: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 从 0 到 1 深度手册：安装/插件开发/性能调优/实测案例/同模型多 Agent 实测对比（中文 + 英文 PDF）
trending.tagline: DeepSeek从入门到精通的详细手册
trending.explanation: 这是一本关于DeepSeek的深度手册，从安装到插件开发、性能调优都有。它解决的是‘网上资料零散，没有系统学习材料’的问题。它包含实际案例和多个AI模型的对比测试，还有中英文PDF。比如，你想知道如何让DeepSeek跑得更快，或者如何开发自己的插件，这本书都有指导。适合想深入使用DeepSeek的开发者，需要一定基础，但内容很全面。

spaces.name: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora
spaces.desc: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack
spaces.tagline: 一键生成带同步音效的视频
spaces.explanation: 这个工具能根据文字描述自动生成视频，并且自带匹配的音效，就像给视频自动配音。比如你输入“一只猫在钢琴上跳舞”，它就能生成一段猫跳舞的视频，同时配上合适的音乐或声音。对于普通人来说，可以用来快速制作有趣的短视频，不需要任何剪辑或配音技能。学生可以用它来制作创意作业或演示，比如把历史事件变成小短片。上手非常简单，只需输入文字，点击生成，等一会儿就能看到结果，完全不需要技术背景。

spaces.name: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-Music3
spaces.explanation: 这是一个AI音乐生成工具，你可以通过文字描述或选择风格来创作音乐。比如你输入“轻快的钢琴曲，适合早晨”，它就能生成一段完整的音乐。对于普通人，可以用来制作个人背景音乐、播客开场曲，或者为视频配乐。学生可以尝试创作自己的原创音乐，了解音乐结构。上手不难，界面直观，只需输入提示词或选择参数，就能生成音乐，还可以调整长度和风格。不需要懂乐理或乐器。

spaces.name: prithivMLmods/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-LoRAs-Fast
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 快速编辑图片的AI工具集
spaces.explanation: 这个工具集合了多种图片编辑功能，比如改变图片风格、添加物体、修改细节等。比如你有一张风景照，可以输入“把天空变成星空”，它就能修改图片。对于普通人，可以用来美化照片、制作创意图片。学生可以用它来学习图像处理概念，比如风格迁移。上手简单，通常只需上传图片并输入指令，选择不同的LoRA模型即可。不需要专业修图技能，但可能需要尝试几次才能得到满意效果。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.explanation: 这个工具可以根据一张静态图片和文字提示生成视频。比如你有一张人物照片，输入“他正在挥手”，就能生成人物挥手的动态视频。对于普通人，可以用来制作动态头像、让老照片动起来，或者为社交媒体创作有趣内容。学生可以用它来制作动态演示，比如让历史人物“说话”。上手简单，只需上传图片并输入动作描述，点击生成即可。不需要视频编辑经验。

spaces.name: zai-org/OpenVuln
spaces.desc: Find bugs in your repository with GLM
spaces.explanation: 这个工具能自动扫描你的代码仓库，找出潜在的bug和安全漏洞。比如你写了一个Python程序，它可以检查出内存泄漏或逻辑错误。对于普通程序员或学生，可以用来提高代码质量，学习常见错误。上手有一定难度，需要将代码仓库连接到这个工具，但操作有指引。适合有一定编程基础的人，但不需要深入的安全知识。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
models.tagline: 多模态AI模型，能看图说话
models.explanation: 这是一个大型AI模型，可以同时处理文字和图片，比如回答关于图片的问题、根据图片生成描述。比如你给它一张猫的照片，问“这是什么品种”，它能回答。对于普通人，可以用来识别图片内容、辅助学习。学生可以用它来练习英语，比如描述图片并让AI纠正。上手简单，通常通过网页或API使用，不需要技术背景。但模型较大，可能需要一定计算资源。

models.name: unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
models.explanation: 这是Qwen3.8-27B模型的压缩版本，文件更小，运行速度更快，适合在普通电脑上运行。比如你可以在自己的笔记本上运行它，进行文本生成或问答。对于普通人，可以体验AI对话，无需高端硬件。学生可以用它来学习AI模型部署。上手相对简单，下载后使用特定软件加载即可，但需要一些命令行操作，适合有一定技术兴趣的人。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B
models.tagline: 超大规模AI模型，擅长生成文本
models.explanation: 这是一个拥有2.4万亿参数的巨型AI模型，专门用于文本生成，比如写文章、对话、翻译等。比如你可以让它写一篇关于环保的短文。对于普通人，可以通过API使用，获得高质量的文本生成服务。学生可以用它来辅助写作、练习英语。上手简单，只需调用API，但可能需要付费或申请权限。模型很大，但用户无需关心底层技术。

models.name: meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B
models.tagline: 理解图片和文字的AI模型
models.explanation: 这个模型能同时理解图片和文字，比如根据图片回答问题、生成描述。比如你给它一张图表，问“趋势如何”，它能分析。对于普通人，可以用来获取图片信息、辅助学习。学生可以用它来学习图像识别和自然语言处理。上手简单，通过网页或API使用。但模型较大，可能需要一定资源。

models.name: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
models.explanation: 这个工具能将静态图片转换成动态视频，比如让照片中的人物动起来。比如你有一张风景照，可以生成风吹草动的视频。对于普通人，可以用来制作动态壁纸、创意视频。学生可以用它来学习视频生成技术。上手简单，上传图片并设置参数即可，不需要视频编辑经验。

items.title_en: Can We Defend Against AI-Generated Video Attacks on Real-World Crisis Events? A Systematic Evaluation of Detectors, Generators and Social Dissemination
items.summary: Recent video generators can fabricate realistic depictions of wars, disasters, public emergencies, and other real-world crises, creating substantial risks of misinformation. Existing benchmarks, however, provide limited evidence on detector and generator behavior in such settings, including how detectability varies with generation conditions, how people perceive generated videos, and whether detectors remain reliable during social dissemination. To address this gap, we introduce RA-Bench, a benc
items.title_cn: 我们能防御针对真实世界危机事件的AI生成视频攻击吗？对检测器、生成器和社会传播的系统评估
items.note: 研究AI生成视频在危机事件中的风险，评估检测器性能，对关注AI安全的新手有参考价值。

items.title_en: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Visual on-policy distillation relies heavily on an informative teacher-student asymmetry, through either a larger, stronger teacher or privileged supervision, such as reference answers or ground-truth regions of interest. This raises a fundamental question: where can informative asymmetry come from when nothing privileged is available? We answer this by inverting where the asymmetry comes from. Rather than adding privileged information to the teacher, we subtract information from the student. Th
items.title_cn: 自监督视觉在策略蒸馏
items.note: 提出无需特权信息的视觉蒸馏方法，通过减少学生信息而非增加教师信息，对理解蒸馏技术有帮助。

items.title_en: Beyond Final Scores: A Systematic Evaluation of Agents for Long-Horizon AI Research and Development
items.summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly capable of improving models, systems, and other technical artifacts through long-horizon experimentation. To understand the current state of this capability, however, evaluation must go beyond final scores, which neither reveal where progress is gained or lost nor indicate whether accumulated experience improves later decisions. We therefore present a systematic evaluation of seven frontier models on 36 long-horizon tasks based on a new framework that uses rule
items.title_cn: 超越最终分数：对长时程AI研发智能体的系统评估
items.note: 系统评估7个前沿模型在36个长时程任务上的表现，揭示进步与失败之处，对了解智能体评估方法有益。

items.title_en: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
items.summary: We introduce Mobius-v0, an architecture that comprises a globally shared Memory (FFN) that stores knowledge vectors and multiple Reasoners (Self-Attn) that iteratively achieve compositional reasoning. Using hidden states as cache and carrier, reasoners repeatedly query memory for required knowledge-vectors, while the knowledge is transmitted back to reasoning operators. Through this knowledge-reasoning-separation architecture, Mobius achieves better knowledge compression and reasoning efficiency
items.title_cn: Intern-S2-Mobius：具有解耦知识与推理的基础模型
items.note: 提出知识存储与推理分离的架构，提升知识压缩和推理效率，对关注模型设计的新手有启发。

items.title_en: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
items.summary:
Apollo did not reach the Moon merely because its engineers could solve difficult equations. It succeeded by turning a distant ambition into a mission architecture of explicit objectives, simulation, verification, and repeated correction. AI now faces a similar transition: frontier models can solve difficult tasks once the problem, tools, and success criteria are specified, yet consequential real-world challenges rarely arrive in an executable or verifiable form.
  We introduce Apodex Discovery,
items.title_cn: Apodex Discovery：用于评估和构建发现型人工智能的现实基准与环境
items.note: 类比阿波罗登月，提出构建发现型AI的框架，强调目标明确和验证，对理解AI研究范式有帮助。

items.title_en: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
items.summary: Interactive world models must support persistent memory, responsive interaction, and long-horizon generation, yet these requirements place conflicting demands on the model. Maintaining history in the denoiser context or key-value cache incurs growing cost, forcing a trade-off between session length and retained memory, while low-latency interaction relies on few-step generation whose capabilities are bounded by its teacher. Evoke addresses both limitations by externalizing persistent world state
items.title_cn: Alaya-EVOKE：从线性扩展监督到无尽世界
items.note: 解决交互式世界模型的持久记忆和低延迟生成问题，对关注AI交互应用的新手有参考价值。

items.title_en: LLMRouter: Unified Infrastructure for Developing, Evaluating, and Deploying LLM Routers
items.summary: No single large language model (LLM) is optimal across all queries and budget constraints, making model routing essential for cost-effective deployment. Existing routers adopt diverse formulations and implementations, making fair comparison and extension difficult. We present a unified formulation of LLM routing as a sequential decision process characterized by five components: context encoders, model encoders, scoring functions, decision rules, and learning signals, covering single-turn, multi-
items.title_cn: LLMRouter：用于开发、评估和部署LLM路由器的统一基础设施
items.note: 提出统一LLM路由框架，涵盖多轮决策，对理解模型部署优化有帮助。

items.title_en: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: We present DreamX-Phi 1.0, an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation that, given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence comprising end-effector poses and gripper states, predicts the resulting future observations. Yet realism alone does not guarantee faithfulness: a convincing rollout can still move the wrong arm or lose the manipulated object. To ensure the prediction respects each arm's commanded path, we inject per-arm SE(3) transfor
items.title_cn: DreamX-Phi 1.0：用于机器人操作的动作条件视频世界模型
items.note: 预测机器人操作未来帧，注入每臂变换确保忠实，对机器人学习感兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
items.summary: An LLM agent's capability depends not only on model weights but on its harness: prompts, tools, skills, and control flow. Self-improvement loops already edit harnesses, yet single-lineage search is path-dependent and local wins often regress other tasks. We introduce DarwinX, which treats self-evolution as selection over a population of harnesses with the model frozen: a preserve-and-extend contract admits only variants that extend coverage without regressing, an archive keeps alternative lineag
items.title_cn: DarwinX：通过自然选择进化智能体工具包
items.note: 将智能体进化视为工具包群体的选择，保持模型冻结，对理解智能体自我改进有启发。

items.title_en: Intern-S2-Preview: Scientific Agentic Foundation Model
items.summary: Scientific discovery increasingly requires AI systems that can reason over scientific evidence of heterogeneous modalities, interact with scientific tools and environments, and sustain progress across long task horizons. We present Intern-S2-Preview, a series of scientific agentic foundation models designed to support multimodal scientific understanding, reasoning, generation, and long-horizon tasks. The training pipeline begins with scientific multimodal pre-training over rendered scientific do
items.title_cn: Intern-S2-Preview：科学智能体基础模型
items.note: 面向科学发现的多模态智能体模型，支持长时程任务，对AI for Science感兴趣者可关注。

items.title_en: Spark-to-Paper: End-to-End Research Paper Generation as a Composable Skill
items.summary: Turning a research idea into a complete paper requires more than text generation: the system must retrieve literature, design and execute experiments, revise claims according to evidence, produce publication-ready figures, and maintain consistency across a long generation process. We present Spark-to-Paper, an end-to-end research paper generation system implemented as thirteen composable skills inside an existing coding assistant, without requiring a separate agent platform or orchestration serv
items.title_cn: Spark-to-Paper：端到端研究论文生成作为可组合技能
items.note: 将论文生成分解为13个技能，无需独立平台，对学术写作自动化有兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
items.summary: AI agents operate in persistent environments where early state changes can influence decisions far into the future. Unlike conventional language-model interactions, agent behavior is mediated through a shared state that is repeatedly modified and reused across long-horizon workflows. Current safety benchmarks often fail to capture these cumulative risks because they focus on short, static tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce OpenART, an open-ended arena for scalable agent red teamin
items.title_cn: OpenART：通过开放式环境进化扩展智能体红队测试
items.note: 提出开放式竞技场用于智能体红队测试，关注长期累积风险，对AI安全评估有价值。

items.title_en: AI4AI at Test-Time: Strong-to-Weak Capability Transfer via Harnesses
items.summary: Recent work on distillation transfers the capabilities of large models to smaller ones often by updating the latter's parameters, through teacher forcing, on-policy distillation, and related training-time methods. In this paper, we ask whether such transfer can instead occur at test time. We study strong-to-weak scaffolding: whether a stronger builder model can construct inference-time harnesses that help a weaker target model solve tasks more reliably without any parameter updates. Using four r
items.title_cn: 测试时AI4AI：通过工具包实现强到弱能力迁移
items.note: 研究测试时构建推理工具包帮助弱模型，无需参数更新，对模型压缩和迁移学习有启发。

items.title_en: Mechanist: AI as a Scientific Instrument for Discovering the Mechanisms of Intelligence
items.summary: AI models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet the mechanisms underlying their capabilities and the risks they may pose remain poorly understood. As AI development becomes faster and increasingly automated, mechanistic exploration remains largely manual, widening the gap between what models can do and our ability to understand and control them. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mechanist, an agentic system that uses AI as a scientific instrument for the autonomous discover
items.title_cn: Mechanist：AI作为科学仪器发现智能机制
items.note: 用AI自动探索模型机制，缩小理解与控制差距，对可解释性研究有价值。

items.title_en: SkillZip: Contract-Preserving Graph Compression for Scalable Agent Skill Libraries
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents whose procedural knowledge is stored in reusable skill packages and loaded at inference time. As skill libraries grow, a central challenge is to expose the smallest sufficient executable context under a limited context budget. Existing systems struggle to reuse routines below the whole-skill level, preserve procedural contracts during compression, keep compressed routines executable and expandable, and update the compressed library as skill
items.title_cn: SkillZip：用于可扩展智能体技能库的契约保留图压缩
items.note: 压缩技能库同时保留程序契约，解决上下文预算问题，对智能体系统设计有帮助。

items.title_en: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
items.summary: After an older adult misses a medication dose, a software agent can send another reminder and an embodied agent can bring the medication. Yet neither explains whether the person forgot, is confused, has side effects, or deliberately refused, nor what support is appropriate. This reveals a structural gap in Agentic AI: Digital Agents primarily transform software states, while Embodied Agents transform physical states; neither makes a person's evolving state and agency the primary object of modeli
items.title_cn: ComBodied Agents：以人为中心的智能体AI新范式
items.note: 提出结合数字与具身智能体的新范式，关注人的状态，对AI应用设计有启发。

items.title_en: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
items.summary: 4D generation synthesizes dynamic 3D scenes from conditions such as text or images. Existing methods either reconstruct generated RGB videos with a separate 4D model or adapt a particular video generator to predict geometry directly. The former suffers from distribution mismatch and error propagation, whereas the latter ties 4D prediction to a specific generator and may require retraining when the generator or conditioning regime changes. We ask whether the final denoised latents of video models
items.title_cn: 超越像素：从视频先验到4D世界
items.note: 利用视频模型潜变量生成4D动态场景，避免分布不匹配，对3D生成感兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: Co-Evolution in Agentic Systems: Toward Self-Directed Evolution Beyond Human Design
items.summary: Agentic systems are increasingly expected to improve after deployment, yet single-entity self-evolution is often bounded by a static learning context, such as fixed tasks and feedback. This survey focuses on co-evolution in agentic systems, a multi-component form of self-evolution in which multiple agents and their environment impose adaptive pressure on one another. To organize existing papers, we propose a progressive three-stage taxonomy that traces how the system gradually sheds human-engine
items.title_cn: 智能体系统中的共同进化：走向超越人类设计的自我导向进化
items.note: 综述多智能体共同进化，提出三阶段分类，对理解智能体进化趋势有帮助。

items.title_en: Articulated Object Reconstruction from Rest-State Observation
items.summary: Building interactive digital twins requires recovering both 3D geometry and the kinematic structures that govern how objects articulate. Yet existing methods for articulated object reconstruction require explicitly observable motion from multiple articulation states. We introduce a rest-state formulation that reconstructs articulated objects from a single closed configuration, an inherently ill-posed setting where geometry, semantics, and motion priors compensate for the absence of motion cues.
items.title_cn: 从静止状态观察重建铰接物体
items.note: 从单一闭合配置重建铰接物体，利用几何和运动先验，对3D视觉有兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
items.summary: Fréchet distance has recently emerged as an effective distribution-level objective for generator post-training, complementing the conventional sample-level diffusion and flow-matching losses. However, directly optimizing Fréchet objectives can cause Fréchet hacking. The target metrics keep improving, but visual quality and Fréchet alignment in other feature spaces may stagnate or deteriorate. We attribute this failure to the static pretrained feature spaces used by existing Fréchet losses. These
items.title_cn: AdvFD：通过对抗Fréchet距离损失提升视觉生成
items.note: 改进Fréchet距离损失，避免黑客攻击，提升生成质量，对生成模型训练有参考。

items.title_en: BDH-CQ: In-Context Learning with Recurrent Latent Reasoning
items.summary: We introduce BDH-CQ, a reasoning model that combines in-context learning with recurrent latent reasoning. Inputs presented at inference time continuously update the model's recurrent memory; the model then solves a query through iterative computation in a high-dimensional latent space, without verbalizing its intermediate reasoning. We evaluate the model on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set and use controlled ARC-like interventions to study what it learns from demonstrations, how consistently
items.title_cn: BDH-CQ：具有循环潜在推理的上下文学习
items.note: 结合上下文学习与循环潜在推理，在ARC-AGI上评估，对推理模型研究有帮助。

items.title_en: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
items.summary: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, c
items.title_cn: Macaron-V1：迈向具有自我改进和LoRA混合的开放持续学习
items.note: 提出开放智能体模型族，通过递归改进和Mixture-of-LoRA实现持续学习，对终身学习有兴趣者可关注。

items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
items.summary: On-policy (Self-)Distillation (OPD / OPSD) has shown strong potential for post-training large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods still rely heavily on external supervision, including ground-truth signals, environmental feedback, or guidance from larger models, and therefore fall short of genuine "self"-distillation. In this study, we show that on-policy self-distillation can be achieved using only a model's own generations via internal consistency. We propose unsupervised on-polic
items.title_cn: 无监督的在线策略自蒸馏
items.note: 仅利用模型自身生成实现自蒸馏，无需外部监督，对自监督学习有启发。

items.title_en: SWE-Bench ProMax: Benchmarking Agents on Large-Scale Multilingual Code Refactoring
items.summary: As AI coding agents take on increasingly complex, long-horizon software engineering tasks, existing benchmarks are rapidly saturating and their evaluation quality has come under serious scrutiny: a recent audit found that nearly 60% of unsolved SWE-bench Verified instances contain flawed tests -- either overly narrow tests that reject correct solutions or overly broad tests that check unstated requirements -- and that frontier models can verbatim reproduce gold patches from training data. Code r
items.title_cn: SWE-Bench ProMax：大规模多语言代码重构智能体基准
items.note: 提出新基准评估代码重构智能体，指出现有基准缺陷，对软件工程AI有参考。

items.title_en: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.summary: Leading large language model providers now conceal their models' step-by-step reasoning, or chain-of-thought, to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage. Rather than storing these traces server-side, providers return them to the client as blocks of encrypted text, which the client passes back with each subsequent request. Building on prior research, we identify an architectural vulnerability: these encrypted blocks are fully compatible and interchangeable across different ses
items.title_cn: 从专有LLM API窃取推理轨迹
items.note: 发现加密推理轨迹的架构漏洞，可跨会话重用，对AI安全有警示。

items.title_en: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
items.summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods require costly future generation at inference. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing the video branch t
items.title_cn: SimWAM：用于端到端自动驾驶的简单世界动作模型
items.note: 用视频生成作为训练信号，避免推理时生成，提升自动驾驶效率，对自动驾驶AI有兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
items.summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) exhibit fundamentally different behaviors in enhancing multi-task reasoning for large language models (LLMs). Our preliminary experiments revealed a phenomenon: SFT suffers from severe task conflicts under multi-stage training, whereas RL enables stable coexistence across diverse tasks. Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks. We provide a the
items.title_cn: SFT冲突，RL共存：多任务学习LLM的理论与实证分析
items.note: 分析SFT和RL在多任务学习中的不同行为，RL更稳定，对训练策略选择有指导。

items.title_en: MatrAIx: Simulating the World with 8.3 Billion Persona Agents
items.summary: Human evaluation of AI systems and digital products is costly, slow, and difficult to scale. Offline evaluations are more scalable but often abstract away human diversity and interactive behavior. We therefore introduce MatrAIx, a population-scale simulated-user evaluation infrastructure for testing AI systems and digital products with heterogeneous users. MatrAIx has three core components: First, Persona 8B contains 8.3 billion persona records represented by 1,290 categorical dimensions. Record
items.title_cn: MatrAIx：用83亿人设智能体模拟世界
items.note: 构建大规模模拟用户评估基础设施，含83亿人设记录，对AI系统评估有参考。

items.title_en: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
items.summary: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability
items.title_cn: 超越简单环境扩展：为多模态智能体学习设计有效环境分布
items.note: 研究环境多样性和难度结构对智能体学习的影响，提出更有效的分布设计，对训练智能体有帮助。

items.title_en: Small Foundation Models of Human Cognition and Behaviour
items.summary: Large language models fine-tuned on human behavioural data have emerged as general-purpose cognitive proxies, but the scale this requires, and whether these models process task structure or exploit statistical shortcuts, remain open questions. We train fourteen models from 135M to 14B parameters across four architecture families on Psych-101, a dataset of 10.7 million trial-level choices from 160 experiments. For in-distribution simulations, scale barely matters. The models fall within a narrow
items.title_cn: 人类认知和行为的小型基础模型
items.note: 训练小模型模拟人类行为，发现规模影响不大，对认知建模有兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards constructs trajectory-level advantage estimates, yet it often fails to credit the few pivotal decisions that determine outcomes in long-horizon, multi-turn agentic tasks. Recent work introduces privileged self-distillation for credit assignment, providing denser supervision, but it remains unclear how such local signals should represent sequential credit. We propose AgentOPSD, a critic-free, recursive method for turn-level credit assignment in
items.title_cn: AgentOPSD：用于智能体强化学习的递归自蒸馏
items.note: 提出无评论家的递归方法进行回合级信用分配，提升长时程任务学习，对RL研究有参考。

items.title_en: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale
items.summary: Generating large-scale, freely explorable 3D worlds from open-ended text remains challenging because a system must jointly maintain global spatial coherence, rich local content, and explicit assets suitable for downstream editing and reuse. We present WorldClaw, a fully agentic, coarse-to-fine framework for open-world 3D scene generation. Planning agents translate a text prompt into a structured specification of regions, terrain, assets, materials, and spatial relations. WorldClaw then builds a
items.title_cn: WorldClaw：大规模智能体3D开放世界生成
items.note: 用智能体规划生成大规模3D世界，保持全局一致性和可编辑性，对3D内容生成有兴趣者可关注。

items.title_en: OSReward: Instituting Standardized Evaluation for Cross-Platform Computer-Use Reward Models
items.summary: Computer-using agents (CUAs) are advancing rapidly across the digital world. A CUA trajectory records the agent's actions, states, and reasoning. Verifying whether it fulfilled the task instruction is central to CUA evaluation, data curation, and reinforcement learning. Neither human-written verifiers nor human annotators can provide such verification at scale, so the field increasingly turns to vision-language models (VLMs) as judges of CUA trajectories. But a fundamental question has long gone
items.title_cn: OSReward：为跨平台计算机使用奖励模型建立标准化评估
items.note: 提出标准化评估计算机使用智能体轨迹的奖励模型，对智能体评估有帮助。

items.title_en: Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval
items.summary:
Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from non-invasive magnetoencephalographic (MEG) recordings by deep networks trained with a CLIP-style objective against wav2vec 2.0 audio embeddings. Yet their weights do not map onto electrophysiological quantities, and it remains unclear which speech properties drive retrieval.
  We build on a high-performing MEG-to-audio retrieval architecture but redesign both its front end and decoder. Its spatial attention operates on a flattened sensor l
items.title_cn: 可解释的MEG语音解码：皮层来源和驱动检索的刺激特征
items.note: 改进MEG语音解码架构，提高可解释性，对脑机接口和神经科学有兴趣者可了解。

items.title_en: GST-Bench: Can VLMs Develop Global Spatial Awareness from Video?
items.summary: Spatial intelligence is fundamental to embodied agents, yet existing benchmarks focus on local spatial perception from single or few viewpoints, overlooking global spatial awareness over continuous, long-horizon visual streams. To address this limitation, we introduce the Global-Spatial-Temporal Benchmark (GST-Bench), a VQA benchmark for global spatial intelligence in video understanding, comprising human-verified questions derived from 6,790 minutes of synthetically generated video. It requires
items.title_cn: GST-Bench：VLM能否从视频发展全局空间意识？
items.note: 提出全局空间时间基准测试，评估视频理解中的全局空间智能，对多模态AI有参考。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型（Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B、Muse-Glimmer-30B、LTX-2.5）整体趋势是向多模态发展，即同时处理文字、图片和视频，且模型规模越来越大，能力更强。对于想跟进AI圈的人，要注意多模态是未来方向，同时模型压缩和高效部署也很重要。备考AI方向时，应关注模型架构、训练数据、多模态融合等概念，并动手实践使用这些模型。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文主要围绕AI智能体、生成模型、安全评估和训练方法等方向。热门趋势包括：智能体的自我进化与共同进化、世界模型与视频生成、AI安全与红队测试、以及更高效的训练技术如自蒸馏和强化学习。对新手而言，值得记住的关键词有：智能体、世界模型、自蒸馏、红队测试、多模态、长时程任务、以及模型评估。这些方向展示了AI从单一模型向复杂系统发展，并注重安全与实用性。
